title: Wandering west from Thornwold's North Track (via 'an Ironbound wayfire') silently leaves Thornwold and drops the party into a different, unrelated hold (Emberfall/Glasswick) with no on-screen warning that this path exits the hold being explored; the mistake only becomes clear once Emberfall's own arrival banner fires two rooms later.
where: The North Track (Thornwold) → 'go west (toward an Ironbound wayfire)' → The Ironbound Wayfire → Emberfall's East Road
